CommonDataSettings.GetPatientQuery: SELECT id, dateofbirth, firstname, lastname, sex FROM SQLUser.tPatients WHERE PatientID1 = '{0}'
CommonDataSettings.GetHostsQuery: SELECT rhcaHost->Hostname, TCPCfg.ConnectionName, IFNULL(TCPCfg.IPaddress, '{0}') as IPaddress, TCPCfg.TCPPort, TCPCfg.IsServer FROM SQLUser.thcaUsedConfig hcaUC LEFT JOIN tcomPortTCPCfg TCPCfg on TCPCfg.id=hcaUC.rcomPortTCPCfg WHERE hcaUC.status=1
CommonDataSettings.GetHostByIdQuery: SELECT rhcaHost->Hostname, TCPCfg.ConnectionName, IFNULL(TCPCfg.IPaddress, '{0}') as IPaddress, TCPCfg.TCPPort, TCPCfg.IsServer FROM SQLUser.thcaUsedConfig hcaUC LEFT JOIN tcomPortTCPCfg TCPCfg on TCPCfg.id=hcaUC.rcomPortTCPCfg WHERE hcaUC.status=1 and rhcaHost->Hostname = '{1}'
CommonDataSettings.GetInstrumentsQuery: SELECT ID, ConnectionDesc, rInstrumentTypes, '{0}' HostAddress FROM tinstruments WHERE Status=1
CommonDataSettings.GetInstrumentByIdQuery: SELECT ID, ConnectionDesc, rInstrumentTypes, '{0}' HostAddress FROM tinstruments WHERE Status=1 and Id = '{1}'

IcaSettings.LabTestMappingQuery: SELECT distinct rInstruments as Id, tconTestMapping.Test, AnalyserTest, AnalyserSample, rInstruments->Name, hca.ExternalCode FROM tconTestMapping LEFT JOIN tTests ON tconTestMapping.Test=tTests.id LEFT JOIN thcaIETestMapping hca ON tTests.id=hca.internalcode WHERE rInstruments->status=1 AND tTests.status=1 and rhcaIEHostConfig->rhcaHost->Hostname='{0}' ORDER BY rInstruments, AnalyserSample,Test
